As of November 16, the China-Laos Railway has handled a total of 300,600 cross-border passenger trips since the beginning of 2026. This marks the first time that the annual figure has surpassed the 300,000 threshold since the cross-border passenger service on the China-Laos Railway began on April 13, 2023, according to China Railway Kunming Group.
